sub_problems.fills: a given parameter on windowless_kwargs that hands the caller's std streams to the child
sub_problems.what: add keyword-only given=None to windowless_kwargs: None returns today's flags; otherwise add stdin/stdout/stderr = sys.std* for each key not in given whose stream has a usable fileno
sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-20: a child started with **windowless_kwargs() from a no-console parent with an inherited pipe prints nothing; handing the std streams through fixes it; the tester's OR-merge forbids changing the default return.
